sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 864)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across five iconic serial adventures starring Clayton "Bud" Collyer as the Man of Steel on *The Adventures of Superman* for Kellogg's Pep (ocean bathysphere rescue in 1940; Civil Air Patrol saboteurs in 1943; the Scorpion's lair in 1944; swindlers confidence ring in 1945; crooked political boss George Latimer in 1946), and Don McNeill's festive Chicago broadcast on *The Breakfast Club* (1960).
All episode titles maintain pure canonical naming, with multi-part serial numbers cleanly recorded in the `story` attribute and cast/sponsors preserved in the narrative description:
